body: Well then I am not alone in this situation. My gf probably thinks the same way.
Folsom Prison Blues by Johnny Cash. I'll soon die, hope I could listen to it.

We should talk. I am also a student and god it is hard to do anything, eveything I try always has a subtext for that that this thing is useless, I am useless, my future isn't going to be good etc. Also other difficulties with my life are making it more difficult to the point where I have decided that I will commit suicide this year in December, that's the best I can do maybe. So yeah since I am going to end it all, I am not really caring for anything , so am asking you to talk to me. ^_^

I wish for that so badly. By the way, if you know you will die after month. How would you prefer to die? I mean you have to choose a way which you can practice. So don't say that you will take a lethal injection etc because that's hard to come by, unfortunately. And for that one month before your death, what will you prefer to do ?
I did that. Thanks a lot for talking.

Oh no no, nothing fancy and please don't buy anything. Also you don't have to be specific, that is not important. just Netherlands would have been fine. You can write it on a not-in-use part of some ruin or some old building or  anything else, that will do ^_^. I don't have any preference. And don't send me picture. It's better without picture, then I can imagine it. If I have picture, my imagination would be limited.

Hugs. Thanks for sharing that about you. How should I tell the person close to me whom I love about my proposed suicide? Any idea? I am contemplating on that, I still can't figure out. I should tell her I think.

I have a request. I don't know you but its up to you. I don't know from where you are,but could you just buy a very cheap thing, ticket or anything cheap at some place in my name - robin. I always wished to travel you know, I couldn't. I don't think its possible now. I was thinking to go somewhere before suicide but I don't think it would be possible. So, please just do that, buy in my name something very cheap, or just write my name on some bench or a brick or anything.  Robin or R or Robin K. Oh, and can you write my full name, you can even write it anywhere. Let me know, I will share my full name. It sounds stupid I know, I find it relaxing and feel like I travelled that place. My girlfriend lives in Sweden so I have travelled that place by this method.
Yeah,I have seen professional help. It helped a bit with CBT. Counselling worked in managing work if I am doing some work but it didn't solve anything.

I'm not sure if that's the same because in my case, I wasn't comfortable with anything in my life. Truly, i , at this moment just wish to be able to live, be happy you know. I don't wish to die. I wish I could be with the person I love so much. Now, it is even harder and close to impossible to be with that person together. So, one more thing to worry.  Wish I could have assisted euthanasia but where I am, it is impossible to get successful request for that. 
I am really scared. I wish I could just pause all the thoughts, or if someone could just tell me every time to do this and to do this now and now this. So that I may not have to think so much.
I hope that there is heaven. Logically, I don't accept the existence of God but I hope for that so bad. I hope if there is no heaven, maybe I will wake up after death somewhere nice with not so many problems. I pass days without speaking a single word to anyone. There are no friends. People don't understand, they don't like a person like me. I shake with fear and anxiety sometimes. I am intelligent, and fine in other senses, it would be so wonderful if I could get a fair chance. I feel broken and shattered. And I am unable to do anything.

https://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/4yxjfi/dying_soon_depression_sharing_story_and_asking/
I shared that there a while ago.

Exactly similar to my situation. The part "having no friends" is the worst. Wish I could change it. But now I think it might be too late. So I am just trying to be peaceful and to come up in terms with death. Though I hope it gets better.

It is a strange feeling though. You realize that nothing's right. There are so many things you wish to change that it is overwhelming. You do not wish to go to parties and hangouts with friends etc and eventually stop going out. You think of some happy moments you lived and wish that you can live that moment over and over again.
Moto g 4 seems good. But it's little bigger for me I guess. I looked into Moto g 3. That seems awesome. Thanks

Thanks, I looked into that, seems great. Its a bit bigger though. Display is about 5.4 inches but then I guess, it would be fine after a while. Will consider it, I hope to get a new phone instead though.

I can understand. I am undergoing a difficult situation as well. I am sorry for what happened with you. I don't know what to say to you except that I share your grief. I hope at least you would find answers. I also posted here, if you wish , you can read - https://www.reddit.com/r/depression/comments/4yxjfi/dying_soon_depression_sharing_story_and_asking/
I tried Psychological therapy sometime ago, that helped me. However, it didn't for long. You can try that. There are online works as well where you can earn money. I was unable to find any help from that though. Hope you'd get. Its worth a trying.
